scope: Bounded independent source review of the live-exploration migration; not a new full lesson or numerical-model audit.
verdict: No unresolved substantive findings in reviewed interfaces

findings.finding: Live stage evaluation opened the frozen assessment automatically despite promising a separate inspection boundary.
findings.repair: Selection and bound calculations remain live. A distinct Inspect the frozen assessment report action opens assessment data without learner guesses, and the seen flag stays true across reset. Selection receives only validation fields.

findings.finding: Two captions still said the learner was graded on a change.
findings.repair: Captions now describe current-input comparisons; no learner-grading claim.

reviewedProperties: useLiveResult keys evaluation to model-input and comparison-reference serialization; updating a result does not re-trigger the effect indefinitely.
Calculation failures and explicitly blocked drafts retain the last successful result with a visible problem description.
Snapshot and preset operations update a comparison reference explicitly; reset changes the epoch so equal initial inputs still recalculate.
Multi-stage evaluation uses functional per-stage state merges, avoiding lost updates when two child results publish in one React commit.

Active learning query previews derive from current eligible hypotheses and query inputs. Acquiring an oracle label is an algorithm/data action, with bounded hypotheses and queries; manual oracle labels are not learner predictions.
Rademacher fitting/validation/assessment roles remain distinct after the repaired explicit assessment inspection.
Time-series forecasts and actual-error tables derive from the same result.inputs; current controls determine origin, season and declared data edit.
limitations: Source inspection of these six interfaces only; browser and production evidence belong to their owning worker/root.
The full preexisting numerical models and all late-topic lesson prose were not independently re-reviewed.

followup.reason: Final visible-copy cleanup in TimeSeries, Rademacher and Calibration; reread current question/note/description clauses, explicit assessment control and data-role conditions. No unresolved substantive state/protocol issue in the reviewed paths.
